subject: Commit increase & rate tier restructure for ClearCart
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Timothy Walker <tim@clearcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit increase & rate tier restructure for ClearCart

Hi Tim —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. Per our talk, I'm sharing a concise proposal to increase ClearCart's hosted API monthly commit and rebalance the rate tiers to support your new search-personalization workload. Key points in the attached pricing PDF:

- Monthly commit: increase from 1.5M tokens to 3.5M tokens
- New rate tiers: introduction of a mid-volume tier (3.5M–7M) with a 12% unit price reduction vs current overage
- Soft-throttle buffer: 72-hour grace bucket for seasonal spikes (applies for first 3 months)
- SLA & latency: current SLA holds; we'll add a canary rollout window for the new model variant you requested

I've attached a draft SOW + pricing sheet for your procurement team to review. If this looks good, next steps:
1) Confirm the commit uplift and whether you want the 12% mid-volume discount applied immediately or after the initial three-month evaluation.
2) Share procurement contact (PO path or DocuSign).
3) Ops/CS will prepare a migration plan for the model variant and prefix caching to preserve latency.

Marissa, Karthik — tagging you for ops and commercial signoff.

Best,
Jonas
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0189

Attachments: Redwood_ClearCart_Pricing_20270801.pdf; SOW_ClearCart_20270801.docx

From: Timothy Walker <tim@clearcart.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@clearcart.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit increase & rate tier restructure for ClearCart

Jonas —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear options. A few questions from procurement and engineering after a quick pass:

- Procurement: will Redwood accept a net-45 PO? We prefer PO-first for renewals. Also need an invoice flow for monthly commits (not just usage).
- Engineering: can you confirm how the soft-throttle buffer interacts with our bursty traffic? Specifically: will requests beyond the buffer be subject to synchronous 429s or queued and served with higher latency?
- Pricing: curious if the 12% mid-volume discount can be extended to apply retroactively to the month the uplift takes effect (we have a big campaign starting Aug 15).

Cc'ing Sara (finance) to loop procurement.

Thanks —
Tim
Head of Product, ClearCart

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Timothy Walker <tim@clearcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit increase & rate tier restructure for ClearCart

Tim —

Great questions; answers below:

Procurement: we can support net-45 POs on this deal. For renewals we typically push for net-30, but for strategic expansion like this we can accept net-45. I will loop Legal/Finance to document that in the SOW.

Soft-throttle behavior: the 72-hour grace buffer will be applied as a rolling allowance. If you exceed the grace bucket, excess requests will be handled by our soft-throttle policy: requests beyond buffer are queued for up to 150ms to try and preserve success; after that they receive a 429. We will also enable a short-term priority routing for your burst endpoints during the campaign window (we'll document the exact endpoints). Vanessa (ops) — please add the routing note to the migration checklist.

Pricing retroactivity: we can apply the 12% mid-volume discount retroactively to the date the uplift is activated (not retro to previously billed months). We'll need a signed amendment for accounting.

Next steps I propose:
- I'll update the SOW to reflect net-45 and the retroactive mid-volume discount option; add DocuSign link.
- Marissa/Vanessa to create an ops runbook for the Aug 15 campaign including canary timing and KV cache warm-up checklist.
- Karthik to confirm any finance/commercial approvals needed.

If that workflow looks good, can you confirm procurement contact and preferred DocuSign signer?

Thanks,
Jonas

--

Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit increase & rate tier restructure for ClearCart

Thanks team — quick ops notes from CS/Onboarding POV: 

- I'll schedule a kickoff for Wed Aug 11 with ClearCart eng (30 min) to align on canary endpoints and traffic shape.
- Vanessa, we should pre-provision an extra worker pool for Aug 14–21. Recommend GPU headroom: +25% for the first week of the campaign.
- For the KV cache warm-up: we need an agreed sample prompt set and traffic replay by Aug 12. Tim/Sara: can you share a representative sample (1k requests) for warm-up? We will keep it anonymized.

I'll also add the migration checklist to the HubSpot deal (link below).

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/CLRC-2871

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Timothy Walker <tim@clearcart.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit increase & rate tier restructure for ClearCart

Jonas —

From a commercial/legal perspective we need two small clarifications in the SOW amendment:
1) Payment terms: net-45 is acceptable; we need an explicit clause that invoices are issued monthly for the committed units and any overages billed monthly in arrears.
2) Soft-throttle incidents: define an SLA credit trigger if throttling exceeds 0.2% of requests across a 30-day window (we don't want silent degradation).

I'll make those edits and circulate a redline. If ClearCart signs, finance will process the first amended invoice on the next billing cycle.

Karthik
Head of Finance Contracts
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Timothy Walker <tim@clearcart.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commit increase & rate tier restructure for ClearCart

Thanks — all clear. Procurement confirms PO path (net-45) and Sara will send the PO by EOD tomorrow. We'll provide the 1k anonymized request sample for warm-up by Aug 12.

Please go ahead and:
- Send the amended SOW with the payment/invoice language and SLA credit clause for throttling.
- Share the DocuSign link and I'll route to our legal signer (Sara).

Looking forward to the Aug 15 campaign — excited to scale this.

Best,
Tim
Head of Product, ClearCart
